title: Analista de mídias sociais
description:
Social Media da Gamers Brawl

O que você vai fazer:

  • Ajudar a construir a voz da Gamers Brawl nas redes;
  • Transformar stats, batalhas e tretas em conteúdo de qualidade.

title: Consultor SAP ABAP
description:

Localização : São Paulo / SP (Híbrido / Remoto) | Regime de Contratação : PJ

Sobre a Empresa

A Asenium Brasil procura para um profissional qualificado para integrar nossa equipe e atuar no desenvolvimento e otimização de processos críticos de armazenagem, picking, expedição e transportes (WMS e TMS ).

Descrição da Vaga

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e aprimorar soluções ABAP nos módulos SAP EWM e TM, visando a automação e melhoria contínua dos processos logísticos da empresa.

Requisitos

  • Formação Acadêmica : Graduação em Tecnologia, Administração, Logística, Engenharia ou áreas afins.


Experiência :

  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento ABAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de implementação e suporte dos módulos SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) e TM (Transportation Management).


Competências Técnicas

  • Proficiência em ABAP (ECC, EWM, TM, S/4HANA), incluindo CDS, BOPF e AMDP.
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas, como SAP Gateway, OData, REST APIs, IDoc, entre outros.
  • Conhecimento profundo dos módulos MM, SD e EWM, com foco em processos logísticos e cadeia de suprimentos.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente dinâmico e desafiador.
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta e contribuir para a melhoria dos processos logísticos.
  • Flexibilidade de trabalho híbrido/remoto.


Como se candidatar

Se você tem o perfil que estamos procurando, envie seu currículo para nós através do botão de candidatura!

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. Whether you are a sports fan or just curious, EMP is the place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

You Are...

An experienced and driven graphic design professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

﻿

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Graphic Designer. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual content including graphics, logos, branding materials, and typography designs. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics
  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography
  • Strong attention to detail and creativity
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
About Specialty Capital

Specialty Capital was founded just four years ago with a bold idea - to give “debanked” small businesses access to capital that’s Simple, Smart, and Reliable. Today, the company is among the top revenue-based finance companies in the U.S., serving thousands of merchants through a combination of speed, technology, and a deeply human approach. We’re now entering our next chapter and scaling into new financial verticals (credit cards, payments, and neo-bank integrations) and expanding internationally, starting with Canada. The company is profitable, founder-led, and growing rapidly with a culture built on grit, ownership, and mission.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Design and evolve the comprehensive technical architecture for our lending platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Define and maintain architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across all technology initiatives
  • Lead technology selection and evaluation processes for new tools, frameworks, and platforms
  • Create technical roadmaps aligned with business objectives and product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams

Mobile Application Architecture

  • Architect and oversee the development of native mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms
  • Design mobile solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences for loan applications and account management
  • Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services
  • Optimize mobile application performance and offline capabilities


Platform Development

  • Collaborate with SaaS vendors to ensure platform configurations align with architectural standards
  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes


Security & Compliance

  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies
  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures


Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical expertise in node.js, React, Swift, Java/Kotlin development
  • Review code, architectures, and technical designs to ensure quality and standards
  • Facilitate technical discussions and decision-making across teams
  • Establish development standards, coding practices, and documentation requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and technical practices

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; Master's degree preferred
  • 10-15 years of progressive experience in software architecture and development
  • Required: Extensive experience in mobile application development for iOS and Android platforms
  • Strong expertise in Swift for iOS and Java/Kotlin for Android development
  • Proven experience with financial technology platforms and payment systems
  • Deep knowledge of cloud architecture
  • Experience with node.js, React, mySQL, and modern web technologies
  • Strong background in API design, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, and reporting solutions
  • Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and financial services regulations
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in small business lending or commercial finance
  • Experience with Large Language Models / ML implementations in financial services
  • Knowledge of loan origination systems and credit decisioning platforms
  • Experience with React Native or cross-platform mobile development frameworks

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible working arrangements
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of a growing fintech company
  • Professional development opportunities and conference attendance
  • Collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and impact

Join Specialty Capital and play a pivotal role in revolutionizing small business lending through innovative technology solutions. As our Technical Architect, you'll have the opportunity to design systems that directly impact thousands of businesses across the country, helping them access the capital they need to grow and thrive.

Specialty Capital is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

title: Consultor(a) Funcional SAP PP/QM
description:
Consultor(a) SAP PP/QM Senior

Brasil - Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Estamos em busca de um consultor funcional altamente qualificado e experiente, especializado em SAP PP-PI (Planejamento da Produção para Indústrias de Processos) , REM (Manufatura Repetitiva) , MRP (Planejamento das Necessidades de Materiais) , Gestão da Qualidade (QM) e Arquivamento . O consultor será responsável pela documentação, gestão de cronogramas, implantação e suporte pós-implantação (hypercare) das funcionalidades liberadas, seguindo as metodologias e práticas de governança da PepsiCo. É essencial ter habilidade de comunicação eficaz em inglês, tanto falado quanto escrito. O profissional poderá estar localizado em qualquer país da região da América Latina (LATAM).


Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar e compreender os requisitos de negócio para projetar e implementar soluções SAP PP/QM que atendam às necessidades do cliente.
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos para usuários finais, garantindo a adoção bem-sucedida das soluções SAP PP/QM.
  • Realizar análise de processos de negócios e propor recomendações para melhorias.
  • Colaborar com os clientes para identificar e priorizar melhorias nos processos de planejamento da produção.
  • Desenvolver e manter a documentação das configurações, processos e procedimentos do SAP PP/QM.
  • Oferecer suporte contínuo e manutenção dos sistemas SAP PP/QM.
  • Executar testes, configurações, implementações e suporte pós-implantação (hypercare) das soluções.
  • Analisar e preparar objetos para arquivamento.


Habilidades e Qualificações:

  • Experiência comprovada em implementação, configuração e otimização de SAP PP/QM.
  • Sólido conhecimento em princípios e práticas de planejamento da produção.
  • Excelentes habilidades analíticas, de resolução de problemas e de comunicação.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma eficaz em equipes multifuncionais e de construir relacionamentos sólidos com colegas e usuários.
  • Certificações SAP PP/QM ou experiência equivalente (experiência prática em negócios é muito importante).
  • Forte compreensão do SAP ERP e integração com outros módulos (MM, WM, FICO).
  • Inglês técnico (falado e escrito).
  • Capacidade de atuar em múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.
  • Conhecimento sobre produção de bens de consumo.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em qualquer fuso horário da América Latina (México ou Brasil).
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA (desejável).
  • Ingles: avançado
  • Espanhol: intermediário/avançado


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação : Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

title: Fraud Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for a Fraud Risk Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on fraud prevention.

You'll act as the core fraud risk expert, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and design, implement, and oversee effective fraud controls across key local products.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Designing and enhancing fraud prevention controls within Brazil’s 1LoD framework, ensuring alignment with local BCB regulatory expectations and license requirements
  • Performing detailed fraud risk assessments across products (PIX, credit, cards, and business accounts), identifying control gaps and recommending practical mitigations
  • Leading the development and implementation of fraud prevention strategies, including creating and tuning transaction monitoring rules, leveraging data-driven models, and defining robust response workflows
  • Overseeing major fraud incidents and investigations, supporting containment, recovery, and required regulatory reporting processes
  • Partnering closely with Product and Data Science teams to improve automation, detection efficiency, and case triage logic, challenging the status quo for continuous improvement
  • Monitoring and analysing fraud trends and key performance indicators (KPIs) to produce actionable insights and dashboards for local management and committees
  • Strengthening fraud governance, ensuring clear documentation of risks, controls, and residual exposures to demonstrate control maturity during regulatory engagements


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in fraud risk management, prevention, detection, or Investigations within a financial institution or fintech
  • A deep understanding of fraud typologies, detection models, and control frameworks across payment and credit products (PIX, cards, credit)
  • Solid knowledge of local (BCB) FinCrime and fraud regulations and reporting obligations
  • Hands-on experience creating, tuning, and validating fraud detection rules and working with model performance metrics
  • Experience leading complex investigations end-to-end, identifying control weaknesses, and proposing remediation
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, connect data to risk impact, and design pragmatic, scalable solutions
  • A proven ability to partner with Product, Data Science, and Compliance teams to implement risk controls effectively
  • Great communication skills to relay complex fraud and regulatory topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Nice to have


  • Proficiency in using analytical tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Looker)
  • Confidence in presenting risk insights, fraud trends, and remediation updates
  • An interest in developing junior team members as the function scales


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

Lead or participate in the full lifecycle of SAP S/4HANA implementation projects, from planning and blueprinting to go-live and post-implementation support.

Support and Maintenance:

Provide ongoing support for SAP FICO modules, including troubleshooting issues and resolving system errors.

Maintain and update documentation related to SAP FICO modules.

Support data migration activities and system upgrades.

Integration and Collaboration:

Collaborate with other IT teams and functional areas to ensure seamless integration of SAP FICO with other modules and systems.

Work with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve integration issues.

Subject Matter Expertise:

Act as a subject matter expert for SAP FICO, providing guidance and support to other team members and stakeholders.

Stay up-to-date with the latest SAP S/4HANA features and best practices.


Skills and Experience:

Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling modules.

Experience with SAP FICO configuration, implementation, and support.

Proficiency in business analysis, requirements gathering, and solution design.

Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.

Experience with data migration, testing, and training.

Knowledge of integration points with other SAP modules (e.g., SD, MM, PP).

Experience with Central Finance is a plus.

Experience with SAP Ariba and integrations is a plus.

Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud is a plus.

title: SAP FI/CO
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for "SAP FI/CO" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

A SAP FICO S/4HANA consultant specializes in implementing, configuring, and supporting the Finance and Controlling modules within the SAP S/4HANA environment. This involves working with business users to understand their needs, translating those needs into SAP solutions, and ensuring the system effectively supports financial processes. Key responsibilities include leading projects, providing expertise in SAP FICO best practices, and offering ongoing support and training.

Here's a more detailed breakdown of the typical tasks and responsibilities:


Core Responsibilities:

Implementation and Configuration:

Lead or participate in the full lifecycle of SAP S/4HANA implementation projects, from planning and blueprinting to go-live and post-implementation support.

Configure and customize SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) and Controlling (CO) modules, including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), Cost Center Accounting (CO), Profit Center Accounting (PCA), and Internal Orders.

Develop functional specifications, conduct fit-gap analysis, and create documentation for configuration and customization.

Business Analysis and Requirements Gathering:

Work with business stakeholders to understand their financial processes and translate them into system requirements.

Conduct workshops, gather requirements, and document business needs.

Design solutions that align with business requirements and best practices.

Testing and Training:

Develop test plans and scripts for unit, integration, and user acceptance testing.

Conduct testing and support end-users during testing phases.

Provide end-user training on SAP FICO functionalities and processes.

Support and Maintenance:

Provide ongoing support for SAP FICO modules, including troubleshooting issues and resolving system errors.

Maintain and update documentation related to SAP FICO modules.

Support data migration activities and system upgrades.

Integration and Collaboration:

Collaborate with other IT teams and functional areas to ensure seamless integration of SAP FICO with other modules and systems.

Work with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve integration issues.

Subject Matter Expertise:

Act as a subject matter expert for SAP FICO, providing guidance and support to other team members and stakeholders.

Stay up-to-date with the latest SAP S/4HANA features and best practices.


Skills and Experience:

Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling modules.

Experience with SAP FICO configuration, implementation, and support.

Proficiency in business analysis, requirements gathering, and solution design.

Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.

Experience with data migration, testing, and training.

Knowledge of integration points with other SAP modules (e.g., SD, MM, PP).

Experience with Central Finance is a plus.

Experience with SAP Ariba and integrations is a plus.

Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud is a plus.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

Este profissional utiliza ferramentas digitais como e-mail, WhatsApp, telefone e videoconferências para prospectar, negociar e fechar vendas, sem a necessidade de deslocamentos externos. A posição exige um alto nível de conhecimento técnico sobre os produtos, excelente capacidade de comunicação e uma forte habilidade em vendas e persuasão.

  • Realização de apresentações detalhadas sobre os produtos e serviços para os clientes.

  • Profundo conhecimento dos produtos ou serviços oferecidos pela empresa.
  • Habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de CRM e plataformas de comunicação digital.
  • Capacidade de realizar múltiplas tarefas, organizar e priorizar de forma eficaz.


Habilidades:

  • Paciência e habilidade para gerenciar o ciclo de vendas completo, do primeiro contato ao fechamento e follow-up.

  • Agilidade e precisão no atendimento, proporcionando respostas rápidas e soluções adequadas.


Desejável:

Relational Database Management: Work with relational databases like SQL Server and Postgres, including schema design, query optimization, and data integrity maintenance.

Use of Docker/Kubernetes: Utilize Docker for application containerization and Kubernetes for orchestration, facilitating consistent development, testing, and deployment.

Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Work closely with frontend, design, and product teams to ensure business requirements are effectively met.

Continuous Improvement: Identify areas for improvement in code and development processes, promoting agile development and DevOps practices.

Security and Compliance: Ensure applications are secure and comply with relevant standards and regulations.

  • Technical Proficiency: Strong knowledge of .NET Framework, .NET Core, and RESTful API development. Experience with development environments in Azure.

title: SAP ABAP Developer / MDG Specialist (Clean Core Focus)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Projetar e desenvolver soluções ABAP que estendam a funcionalidade do SAP MDG, seguindo os princípios de Clean Core (utilizando BAdIs, extensibilidade para key users e extensões side-by-side).
  • Implementar e dar suporte a modelos de dados, workflows e validações no SAP MDG.
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais para coletar requisitos e propor soluções técnicas escaláveis e compatíveis com upgrades.
  • Desenvolver regras BRF+, interfaces baseadas em Fiori/UI5 e melhorias específicas do MDG utilizando frameworks de extensibilidade.
  • Garantir que todos os desenvolvimentos sejam compatíveis com os caminhos de upgrade do SAP S/4HANA.
  • Participar de code reviews, aplicando padrões de código limpo e diretrizes de extensibilidade SAP.
  • Apoiar integrações com sistemas externos utilizando APIs, OData e serviços do SAP BTP.
  • Fornecer consultoria técnica e suporte em debugging, troubleshooting e correção de erros para aplicações SAP customizadas.
  • Capacitar outros desenvolvedores, promovendo o compartilhamento de conhecimento e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar provas de conceito (PoCs) e projetos que envolvam tecnologias emergentes relacionadas ao ecossistema SAP.
  • Desenvolver e manter ferramentas, guidelines e processos que facilitem o trabalho do time de desenvolvimento SAP.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento ABAP, incluindo:
  • ABAP OO (Object-Oriented ABAP)
  • BAdIs e Enhancement Framework
  • BRF+
  • CDS Views
  • OData e APIs RESTful
  • SAP Fiori/UI5
  • Conceitos de Clean Core e práticas de extensibilidade SAP
  • Técnicas específicas de desenvolvimento para SAP S/4HANA
  • RAP (Restful ABAP Programming) — CDS, Annotations, Behavior Definitions, Managed/Unmanaged Implementation, EML
  • Experiência com SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) e Business Application Studio (BAS)
  • Conhecimento de Solution Manager (ChaRM, Focused Build)
  • Conhecimento em SAP Master Data Governance (MDG):
  • Modelagem de dados e frameworks de governança
  • INGLÊS AVANÇADO/FLUENTE


  • Habilidades comportamentais:
  • Capacidade analítica e foco em qualidade técnica
  • Colaboração com equipes funcionais e técnicas
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua e alinhamento com o conceito de Clean Core
  • Comunicação clara e espírito de equipe


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Vendedor(a) | Inside Sales | Closer
description:
Olá, tudo bem?!


Sou Rodrigo Barbosa, mentor de líderes e empresários, palestrante e especialista em transformar negócios por meio de estratégia, mentalidade e execução. Acredito que resultados extraordinários nascem de clareza, disciplina e protagonismo aplicados com intenção e constância , e é exatamente isso que entregamos na RB Company.

Depois de anos construindo uma carreira exponencial e mentorando centenas de profissionais e líderes, entendi que a grande transformação acontece quando quem está à frente da empresa evolui. É o líder e o empresário crescendo. É o negócio ganhando direção, consistência e velocidade.

Temos uma visão de impactar milhares de empresas nos próximos anos, e essa posição anunciada tem o objetivo de fazer a diferença no crescimento de negócios, acelerando resultados, reconhecimento e valorização por meio de um trabalho estratégico e assertivo.


A vaga anunciada faz parte dessa expansão. Buscamos pessoas que entendem que crescimento é responsabilidade diária e que estão dispostas a entregar o seu melhor todos os dias, porque aqui, performance não é discurso: é prática.


Busco pessoas com mentalidade empreendedora, visão de longo prazo e que estejam abertas a aprender com uma jornada de crescimento e desenvolvimento significativo.


Sobre a Vaga – Closer | Inside Sales


Estamos crescendo rápido e buscamos um(a) vendedor(a) de alta performance para conduzir as negociações e fechar parcerias com profissionais e empresas que buscam aceleração, liderança e crescimento.

• Transformar interesse em decisão: converter leads em clientes com escuta ativa e direcionamento claro.

• Gerenciar o pipeline com excelência: follow-ups, propostas, CRM, gestão da base.

• Ser parte da expansão de uma marca que transforma carreiras no Brasil inteiro.

  • Conhecimento de Solution Manager (ChaRM, Focused Build)

  • Modelagem de dados e frameworks de governança

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Commercial Account Manager
description:
About WSO2:

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI-enabled digital services and applications. Our open source, AI-driven, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in and enables rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

The Commercial Account Executive is responsible for managing and growing existing customer accounts and leveraging new business opportunities. This role requires a strong understanding of customer needs, complex sales projects, the ability to build and maintain long-term relationships, and a proven track record of exceeding sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:

Account Management:

  • Develop and execute account plans to achieve revenue growth and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at existing customer accounts. Ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and provide insightful business reviews to customers.
  • Work closely with other departments (including pre-sales, product, legal, and marketing) to support customer success.

Sales and Revenue:

  • Achieve and exceed assigned sales quotas and revenue targets.
  • Drive client retention, renewals, upsells, and cross-sells.
  • Negotiate and close deals effectively.
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead qualification to contract negotiation and customer onboarding.
  • Contribute to the development of sales strategies and best practices.
  • Gather market intelligence, developments, and competitor activities and share insights with the sales team.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Proven track record of success in a sales role, preferably in the software industry.
  • Experience with long sales cycles, request for proposals, and public tenders.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and enterprise IT environments.
  • Experience with open source software, API management, and IAM technologies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and other sales tools.
  • Native portuguese speaker, fluent in English (oral and written).
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.
  • An opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.
  • An opportunity for professional growth and development.
  • A fully remote position with frequent short travel.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Como Senior DevOps Engineer na área de DTI da Sankhya, você terá a missão de contribuir significativamente com a evolução da nossa cultura de DevOps, elevando a maturidade de processos, ferramentas e práticas. Essa posição terá forte impacto estratégico na estabilidade, automação e governança dos nossos ambientes, sendo referência técnica e parceira das áreas de desenvolvimento, segurança e operações.


Se você busca desafios complexos, autonomia e a oportunidade de influenciar a arquitetura e as práticas de engenharia em escala, essa vaga é para você.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Diagnóstico e plano de ação para maturidade DevOps: mapear processos, ferramentas e práticas atuais, identificando gargalos e propondo um plano de evolução com prioridades claras para eficiência, automação e confiabilidade;
  • Estabilização e automação dos pipelines de CI/CD: puxar a revisão, padronização e automação de pipelines, garantindo versionamento, rastreabilidade e segurança das implantações, além de implementar práticas como blue/green deploy ou rollback automatizado;
  • Governança e confiabilidade dos ambientes: implementar processos e ferramentas que fortaleçam segurança, configuração e monitoramento, utilizando infraestrutura como código (ex.: Terraform), além de fomentar a cultura de observabilidade e resposta proativa a incidentes;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o time de DevOps e promover boas práticas de engenharia em toda a organização;
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de performance e disponibilidade em sistemas distribuídos.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis ;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CI/CD e automação (Jenkins, GitLab, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, ArgoCD, etc.);
  • Vivência em infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares);
  • Conhecimento avançado em linguagens de scripting/automação (Python, Ruby, Shell Script);
  • Linux avançado (obrigatório) e experiência com Windows Server;
  • Fundamentos de redes, protocolos e segurança ;
  • Experiência em cloud computing (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e boas práticas de otimização de custo/performance;
  • Containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes );
  • Experiência com monitoramento, logging e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog ou similares).



Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução tecnológica de um dos maiores ERPs do país, com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de usuários, queremos te conhecer!

  • Replicar e melhorar o conjunto de recursos atual:
  • Páginas de detalhes de produtos

  • Criar uma biblioteca de componentes de interface (UI) baseada em React , seguindo o sistema de design PPG Primer :
  • Reconstruir componentes principais (botões, cabeçalhos, banners, modais, tabelas etc.) para React, usando os tokens de design existentes (atualmente uma biblioteca de componentes em .NET)
  • Garantir acessibilidade, responsividade e personalização
  • Fornecer documentação e exemplos ao vivo usando o Storybook
  • Entregar como um submódulo Git ou pacote privado NPM


3. Framework de Configuração de Lançamento Rápido

  • Entregar um modelo inicial (Starter Template) em Hydrogen para futuras vitrines:
  • Modelos de configuração de ambiente
  • Suporte para substituição de temas conforme a marca de cada região
  • Roteamento, localização e configuração de CI/CD pré-configurados
  • Estrutura de pastas escalável e alternância entre regiões


4. Integração com o CMS Kontent.ai

  • Integrar o Kontent.ai como CMS para todo o conteúdo não relacionado a produtos:
  • Utilizar as APIs GraphQL ou REST do Kontent.ai para entregar conteúdo aos componentes Hydrogen
  • Implementar blocos de conteúdo modulares gerenciados pelo CMS (Hero, Banner Promocional, Depoimentos, FAQs etc.)
  • Habilitar layouts de página dinâmicos e páginas de marketing (ex.: /sobre-nos, /sustentabilidade)
  • Integração no nível de rotas: permitir que o CMS controle navegação e estrutura de layout
  • Suporte a campos de conteúdo localizados para vitrines multilíngues e multi-regiões
  • Implementar funcionalidade de pré-visualização segura para revisar atualizações de conteúdo em ambiente de testes

title: Engenheiros de IA
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

  • Inglês Fluente

title: SAP Automation Developer QA/Tester
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Automation Developer QA/Tester who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and execute test concepts, automated or manual test script for cross platform mobile app SAP Service and Asset Manager and foundation framework Mobile Development Kit for Windows.

Follow SAP’s software quality standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in automation development and testing for mobile applications, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, with Behavior Driven Development, Java, JMeter, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system, Jenkins etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to clarify UI Figma design requirement for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows.

Document test concept, automation processes, test cases and workflows for reference and future improvement.

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to clarify OData Service features and requirement, to ensure sufficient test coverage.

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, with strong focus on usability, user experience, security, performance and feature correctness. Actively collaborate with frontend and backend developers to report functional issues, crashes, and performance problems, and validate fixes and resolution as required. Ensure test plant and results are maintained in the central Global Test Platform system for reporting and traceability.

Provide sufficient documentations on test environment, test results, re-produce steps

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) on any product documentation issues

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Maintain communication and documentation in English. Maintain proper communication and notification with SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Scrum Master SR
description:
Buscamos um(a) Scrum Master Sênior para atuar na criação de cadência para o time, promovendo entregas constantes com agilidade e foco em melhoria contínua dos processos. Você será facilitador(a) do fluxo de trabalho, parceiro(a) de PO e engenharia, e referência em cultura ágil orientada a valor e métricas.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Estabelecer e sustentar a cadência do time, facilitando rituais e garantindo fluxo de trabalho.

  • Forte habilidade de comunicação, influência sem autoridade, mediação de conflitos e coaching de times.

title: Analista de Quality Assurance Pleno
description:
Quem somos

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção digital global, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, a Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


Sobre a Vaga

Você será responsável por entregar projetos digitais “limpos”, seguindo planos de testes e criando tickets de bugs impecáveis, conforme os protocolos de qualidade global. Também será responsável pela garantia de qualidade com foco na funcionalidade e compatibilidade dos projetos analisados. Os tickets de bugs registrados devem ser escritos do ponto de vista técnico e podem incluir sugestões de correções ou soluções alternativas. Nossos projetos são baseados principalmente em ações de marketing focadas em e-mails marketing e banners que precisam estar em conformidade com os diferentes navegadores, sistemas operacionais e dispositivos, garantindo o correto carregamentos em todos eles.


Responsabilidades

• Garantir que a equipe de desenvolvimento tenha sempre a lista de todos as versões de dispositivos, sistemas operacionais e navegadores que serão usados nos testes para garantir uma entrega de qualidade.

• Assumir a propriedade dos projetos de controle de qualidade atribuídos desde o início até à entrega;

• Executar planos eficazes para controle de qualidade, revisão e auditorias, entregando projetos “limpos” e livres de bugs;

• Contribuir para o design e validar a funcionalidade dos conceitos de design;

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com gerentes de projetos e desenvolvedores para garantir a qualidade e a conclusão dos projetos no prazo;

• Desenvolver materiais de boas práticas para que os demais grupos adjacentes à tecnologia realizem suas verificações de qualidade em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do projeto.


Pré-requisitos

• Experiência com campanhas digitais com testes em E-mails e Banners;

• Bacharel em Desenvolvimento de Software, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;

• Inglês avançado (seu time de contato direto será global);

• Certificação em Doubleclick Banner (desejável);

• Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Analista de Quality Assurance ou UX;

• Conhecimento dos principais navegadores da Internet, capaz de usar Mac e PC, ter conhecimento de plug-ins de navegador como JavaScript, Flash, etc., familiarizado com tablets (Android, iPad) e smartphones;

• Experiência em ambiente de agencia de publicidade, ou similar.


Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

title: Engenheiro de dados GCP
description:
Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Dados com sólida experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados. Este profissional terá papel fundamental no desenho, desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de integração de dados confiáveis, escaláveis e seguras. O candidato ideal deve ter forte conhecimento em plataformas de nuvem, práticas modernas de engenharia de dados e perfil analítico para garantir o fluxo eficiente de dados na organização.

Responsabilidades Principais

Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines ETL/ELT para ingestão, transformação e entrega de dados estruturados e não estruturados.

Implementar frameworks de ingestão de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes (bancos de dados, APIs, arquivos, streaming etc.).

Garantir qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados por meio de validação, monitoramento e testes automatizados.

Otimizar fluxos de processamento de dados visando custo e performance.

Colaborar com Cientistas de Dados, Analistas e áreas de negócio para fornecer datasets limpos, confiáveis e bem documentados.

Trabalhar com serviços nativos de nuvem (ex.: BigQuery, Dataproc, Dataflow, Databricks, Snowflake) para implementar arquiteturas escaláveis.

Aplicar boas práticas de CI/CD, versionamento e Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) em pipelines de dados.

Assegurar conformidade com normas de segurança, governança e privacidade (ex.: PII, GDPR, LGPD).

Qualificações Necessárias

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência comprovada em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines.

Domínio em SQL, Python e Spark.

Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Google Cloud Platform, AWS ou Azure).

Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados, data warehouse e arquiteturas lake/lakehouse.

Vivência com ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Cloud Composer, Prefect, Dagster).

Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps (Git, pipelines CI/CD, Terraform ou similares).

Diferenciais Desejáveis

Experiência com streaming em tempo real (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis).

Conhecimentos em containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

Vivência com pipelines de machine learning e MLOps.

Experiência com catálogos de dados, metadata management e ferramentas de governança.

Competências Comportamentais

Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara a públicos não técnicos.

Trabalho em equipe, postura proativa e colaborativa.

Inglês fluente (escrito e falado);

espanhol será considerado um diferencial.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the opportunity:

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic environment, leveraging Kubernetes , AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform. In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications,and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and

enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.


work MST or PST hours.



What you get to do every day:

-Participate in an on-call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.

-Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

-Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self-service where possible.

-Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.

-Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.


✅Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux,Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g.,Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)



✨Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in

languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir,java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Partner Enablement Consultant
description:
About Zensar Technologies

Zensar is a leading digital solutions and technology services company partnering with global organizations on their digital transformation journey. A technology partner of choice, with strong track-record of innovation, credible investment in digital solutions and assertion of commitment to client’s success, Zensar’s comprehensive range of services and solutions enable clients achieve new thresholds of performance. Part of the $40 billion APAX Partners’ portfolio of companies, Zensar is uniquely positioned to help existing businesses run efficiently, manage legacy transformation and plan business growth through innovative digital platform.

Working at Zensar

Working at Zensar is an enriching experience. While work is driven by innovation and passion, fun is taken seriously too. An open environment is encouraged making it easy to brainstorm with colleagues. Creative thinking is encouraged through time out activities. Moreover, the offices have been designed to foster creativity and communication, bringing a little bit of home into work every day. Zensar provides and a comprehensive benefit package for all fulltime employees.


Indigo Slate@ Zensar Company is seeking a Partner Enablement Consultant in Brazil (Remote). This is open for Full time remote with outstanding growth opportunities. All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.


Job Description

Consultants are responsible for advising, guiding, scoping, developing strategic learning plans that align to channel partner business teams and their outcomes, with a strong ability to get buy-ins from senior business stakeholders. Consultants act as SMEs for client learning programs (such as certification, products, offerings, tools, processes, training, and exams) and work with technology, L&D and business teams to drive partner workforce capacity and capability by aligning to measurable business outcomes.

Self-driven, analytical, and strategic thinkers—who also have excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to develop and execute plans—will succeed in this consultative role.

T

his is not a role in instructional design, curriculum/content development or training delivery or

operations.


High-level skills and experience

• Strong consultative mindset and consulting skill set with a strong point-of-view on solutions and

recommendations.

• Strategic, ‘big picture’ thinking and connecting the dots.

• Ability to understand the ‘why’ along with the ‘what’ and ‘how’ of a partner need (i.e., well- rounded learning plans that drive business outcomes rather than just chasing headcount/numbers)

• Strong commercial awareness/business acumen of the client’s and channel partner’s business.

• Ability to align learning with client and partner ROI and business drivers.

• Thought leadership with new ideas, strategies, framework, processes to drive results.

• Executive presence and comfortable with public speaking (in-person and virtual) with senior

stakeholders and large audiences

• Data analytics (ability to dig into trends and forecast) and data story telling.

• Technical prowess to understand data/AI/cloud/technical knowledge.

• Highly collaborative across various business functions/senior stakeholder management.

• Proactive and independent, ability to excel in a fast-paced environment while working from vision through execution.


Expected tasks and responsibilities

• Execute frameworks to assess capability and capacity workforce skill gaps in partner organizations.

• Conduct partner needs analysis (discovery and scoping at business, technical and learning levels)

• Enabling consulting conversations with business leaders in partner teams to understand their

business drivers.

• Propose strategic learning plans to all internal and external stakeholders.

• Prescribe relevant learning based on scope and workload (such as certifications, solutions, products,

etc.)

• Build custom partner learning plans, where required, based on the results of scoping/needs analysis and business priority.

• Monitor learner progress and detect any issues.

• Create and present Quarterly/Monthly Business Reviews with senior L&D/Business/Technology

stakeholders

• Monitor and analyze learning stats for data-driven decisions.

• Explore business problems and create different solution models.

• Make recommendations for improvement and present to partners and internal stakeholders.

• Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Qualifications/Requirements

We are looking for individuals with the following qualifications, skills, and experiences:

• 5+ years relevant experience being an L&D consultant or in any business facing consultant role driving outcomes.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Computer Science, or a related field (required)

• Masters candidates (preferred)

• Cloud Digital Leader or Generative AI Leader (GAIL) certifications, preferred but not mandatory

• Experience in the channel partner ecosystem highly preferred


All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.

Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Zensar encourages our employees to seek higher education and training. However, this position will require you to be completely available during work hours.
