title: Webflow Designer
description:
SOBRE A LETS


A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras. Nosso sistema SaaS, chamado Max, é a espinha dorsal que conecta varejistas, operadores logísticos e canais de venda de forma eficiente e automatizada, oferecendo uma experiência simplificada e eficaz para todos os envolvidos. Nossa missão é desenvolver soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que maximizem o desempenho e a eficiência dos negócios, capacitando empresas a alcançar resultados excepcionais.


Estamos crescendo rapidamente e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte de nossa jornada, ajudando a transformar o ecossistema de tecnologia e logística para negócios. Se você é uma pessoa com olhar apurado para produto digital, experiência do usuário e front-end em plataformas low-code/no-code como o Webflow , a LET'S é o seu lugar!


SOBRE A VAGA


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Webflow & Experiência Digital para liderar a evolução do nosso site, blog, landing pages e hubs de conteúdo — conectando marca, performance e produto em uma experiência consistente.


É um papel híbrido entre UX/UI Designer e Front-end Low-Code : alguém que entende jornada, navegação, hierarquia de informação, microcopy e conversão, mas também entra no Webflow para estruturar coleções dinâmicas, componentes, interações, integrações e ajustes finos de layout, responsividade e performance.


Você será “dono(a)” do nosso ecossistema Webflow (e ferramentas associadas), garantindo que tudo esteja organizado, escalável e fácil de manter, sempre conectado com times de Marketing, Growth, Produto e Vendas.


ATIVIDADES:


  • Arquitetura e UX do site : estruturar menus, páginas, fluxos, componentes e coleções (CMS) alinhados à estratégia da LETS e dos produtos (Max SalesCloud, Bippi, FiboNash, etc.).
  • Implementação no Webflow : construir e manter páginas, layouts, coleções dinâmicas, formulários, interações, animações e variações responsivas (mobile-first).
  • Design System & consistência visual : organizar estilos globais (tipografia, cores, grids, componentes), garantindo coerência entre site, blog, LPs e materiais digitais.
  • Performance & SEO On-page : otimizar estrutura, headings, imagens, meta tags, URLs, links internos e boas práticas Core Web Vitals.
  • Integrações & low-code : configurar integrações com ferramentas como HubSpot, AirOps, n8n, WhatsApp/API, analytics, pixels e outros conectores sem depender sempre de dev.
  • Experimentação & conversão : propor e testar variações de páginas, CTAs, formulários e mensagens para melhorar conversão, engajamento e qualificação de leads.
  • Criação de estruturas de landing pages: desenvolver e criar modelos de landing pages escaláveis para eventos, material RICO, e outras formas de conteúdo.
  • Documentação & escalabilidade : registrar padrões, boas práticas e guidelines para que o ecossistema Webflow seja sustentável, organizado e fácil de evoluir.
  • Curiosidade técnica : explorar novas features, clonables, bibliotecas e soluções low-code/no-code que ajudem a levar o site “um passo além” sempre.


REQUISITOS:


Eliminatórios (OBRIGATÓRIO):

  • Experiência comprovada (3+ anos) construindo sites, LPs e projetos profissionais em Webflow .
  • Domínio de UX/UI básico a intermediário : wireframes, hierarquia de informação, boas práticas de navegação e usabilidade.
  • Conhecimento sólido de HTML e CSS (para ajustar o que o Webflow gera e criar soluções mais refinadas).
  • Noções de JavaScript suficientes para pequenas interações, embeds e integrações simples.
  • Experiência com design responsivo e otimização para mobile.
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de documentação técnica, tutoriais e comunidades (inclusive em inglês).
  • Perfil hands-on, curioso, autônomo , com vontade de testar, fuçar, perguntar (inclusive para IAs) e aprender rápido.


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:


  • Experiência com Figma ou ferramenta similar para prototipação.
  • Familiaridade com integrações Webflow ↔ HubSpot , formulários, CRM, automações (n8n/Make/Zapier).
  • Conhecimento em SEO técnico , Analytics, Tag Manager e pixels.
  • Vivência com marcas B2B SaaS, logística, e-commerce ou last-mile.
  • Noções de motion design (Lottie, microinterações, GSAP ou similar).
  • Noções de A/B testing , CRO e métricas de funil.
  • Espanhol ou inglês intermediário.


BENEFÍCIOS:


  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados .
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico .
  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:


  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .
  • Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).
  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .


Como se destacar:

Envie portfólio com projetos em Webflow (links públicos ou clonables), mostrando:

  • antes/depois, raciocínio de UX e decisões de layout;
  • exemplos de coleções dinâmicas, componentes reutilizáveis e interações;
  • casos em que você integrou Webflow com outras ferramentas (CRM, automações, forms, etc.);
  • breve explicação do seu processo (como você estuda, testa, aprende e resolve problemas sozinho(a)).

  • Atuar junto aos times de Produto e Marketing, trazendo insights para evolução do produto.

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly driven Product Manager to lead the end-to-end development of Pointsville’s digital products. You’ll turn ideas into impactful solutions by connecting business goals, user needs, and technical execution. This role focuses on defining vision, setting priorities, and delivering products that drive growth, innovation, and long-term value across emerging technologies and financial ecosystems.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with company goals.
  • Conduct market and competitor research to identify new product opportunities and emerging trends.
  • Gather and analyze requirements from users, partners, and internal stakeholders to inform product design and prioritization.
  • Translate business and technical needs into clear product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage and continuously refine the product backlog, balancing priorities and timelines across multiple initiatives.


Execution and Delivery

  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to create user-centric designs and intuitive experiences.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution of product features and releases.
  • Lead product launches, define success metrics, and coordinate enablement with marketing, sales, and support teams.


Performance and Improvement

  • Monitor product performance post-launch, analyze user feedback, and drive continuous improvement and iteration.
  • Work closely with compliance and legal teams to ensure all product features adhere to regulatory requirements in the crypto and financial services space.
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment, ensuring all teams are informed, empowered, and accountable.
  • Support documentation, go-to-market readiness, and internal communication for each product phase.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of experience in product management, preferably in fintech or financial services, with direct crypto experience.
  • Demonstrated success of launching and scaling successful web and/or enterprise products from concept to launch.
  • Experience with varying development methodologies and leading cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, fintech, or emerging financial technologies preferred.
  • Skilled in data-driven decision making using metrics and analytics tools.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical conversations.
  • High user empathy, strong prioritization abilities, and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Gerente de projetos de TI
description:
Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Como Gerente de Projetos, você trabalhará em colaboração com a equipe do Studio Rx e os times de Projetos e Client Services nos EUA. Diariamente, você deverá monitorar as atividades dos projetos em andamento, identificando e mitigando riscos, além de manter uma comunicação fluída entre todas as equipes envolvidas.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento do plano do projeto: desde o entendimento e definição do escopo/briefing, passando pela estimativa de esforço e elaboração de cronogramas;
  • Alocação de equipe de acordo com habilidades necessárias, experiência e disponibilidade em parceria com o líder técnico da área de execução do projeto;
  • Gerenciamento e monitoramento das atividades diárias do projeto, garantindo o recebimento de todas as informações e materiais para execução das atividades, seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, consolidando as informações em relatórios para a liderança sênior do projeto;
  • Garantir a comunicação entre os times de execução e demais envolvidos no projeto;
  • Esclarecimento de dúvidas quanto ao direcionamento da execução das atividades, interagindo com equipes responsáveis pelo projeto nos EUA;
  • Garantir a execução das atividades de acordo com prazos e tempo estimado, com a qualidade exigida, e seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Elaboração de relatórios de andamento do projeto, e demais relatórios necessários para acompanhamento dos principais indicadores de sucesso das áreas de atuação.


Pré-Requisitos:

  • Inglês fluente (escrito e falado), pois trabalhará diretamente com times globais;
  • Graduação em áreas relacionadas à comunicação (Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração, Comunicação Social) ou TI (Processamento de dados, Análise de sistemas, Ciências da Computação);
  • Experiência consolidada com gestão de projetos.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em agências de comunicação/publicidade;
  • Experiência no segmento healthcare (certificação Veeva é um plus);
  • Proficiência em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (Agile, Scrum etc.);
  • Proficiência em sistemas e/ou softwares de gerenciamento de projetos (MSFT Project, Workfront, Jira etc.)
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas usadas por desenvolvedores front-end e de campanhas digitais (Google Web Designer, Doubleclick Studio, GitHub, Adobe Creative Suite etc.).



Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

title: Pessoa Especialista em Segurança da Informação
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Monitorar e analisar eventos de segurança em tempo real, utilizando ferramentas de SIEM (ex: Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar).
  • Responder a incidentes de segurança (IR) com base em playbooks e procedimentos padronizados.
  • Realizar investigações forenses e análise de comportamento de ameaças (UEBA).
  • Criar e manter alertas inteligentes, regras de correlação e casos de uso de segurança.
  • Trabalhar junto ao time de DevSecOps e Engenharia de Segurança para melhorar continuamente os controles e a detecção.
  • Documentar incidentes, elaborar postmortems de segurança, e realizar melhorias preventivas.
  • Apoiar simulações de ataque e resposta a incidentes (ex: tabletop exercises).
  • Produzir relatórios de inteligência e manter o time atualizado sobre táticas, técnicas e procedimentos (TTPs) utilizadas por agentes de ameaça.
  • Avaliar continuamente a eficácia das ferramentas de SOC e propor ajustes técnicos.
  • Garantir aderência às normas de compliance e governança, como ISO 27001, NIST e LGPD.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • SIEMs: Splunk, Azure Sentinel, QRadar, Elastic SIEM ou similares.
  • Ferramentas de EDR/XDR: CrowdStrike, Defender ATP, SentinelOne, Carbon Black.
  • Ferramentas de Threat Intel: MISP, VirusTotal, OpenCTI.
  • Protocolos de rede e logs: Syslog, NetFlow, PCAP, HTTP, DNS, LDAP, etc.
  • Experiência com automação e resposta com SOAR (ex: Phantom, Demisto).
  • Familiaridade com MITRE ATT&CK e uso de frameworks de cibersegurança. Conhecimentos básicos de scripts: Python, Bash ou PowerShell (desejável).
  • Certificações como CompTIA Security+, CEH, GCIA, GCFA ou equivalente são diferenciais.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Hartmann Young is partnered with a fast-growing global leader in health, nutrition, and wellness ingredients, known for its science-led innovation and rapid international expansion. As the business continues to scale, we are seeking a dynamic Business Development Manager South America to drive immediate commercial impact and elevate the company’s presence across the nutraceutical market.


We’re looking for someone who brings genuine industry influence, including:

  • A strong book of business and established relationships with brand owners, CMOs/CDMOs, and major consumer health companies
  • Proven success selling key nutraceutical dosage forms — tablets, capsules, softgels, and gummys.


If you’re commercially driven, well-connected, and excited by the opportunity to shape partnerships in a high-growth environment, this role offers an exceptional platform to make a meaningful and immediate impact.


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive new business growth by leveraging your existing network and opening high-value commercial opportunities
  • Develop and expand strategic partnerships with global key accounts, brand owners, distributors, and contract manufacturers
  • Lead the full business development cycle — from opportunity identification to negotiation and long-term strategic planning
  • Translate scientific and technical capabilities into compelling commercial propositions
  • Collaborate closely with R&D, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to deliver integrated go-to-market strategies
  • Manage contracts, commercial terms, and performance optimisation across partnership lifecycles
  • Support international expansion through new market development and strategic alliances
  • Represent the business at leading industry trade shows and events to strengthen brand visibility and network reach.


Key Requirements

  • You can be located anywhere within South America to qualify for this market.
  • 8+ years’ experience in business development, partnerships, or commercial leadership within nutraceuticals, ingredients, food, or life sciences within South America.
  • A well-established book of business and strong relationships across the nutraceutical ecosystem
  • Direct experience selling tablets, capsules, softgels, gummys, or related dosage forms
  • Proven ability to generate revenue growth and close complex commercial agreements
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to convert technical innovation into business value
  • Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth, hands-on environment
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Willingness to travel internationally as needed.

title: Saas Product Marketing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes.


About us:


Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you.


But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own


  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Growth Marketing Manager who will become a strategic partner to the CEO and take full ownership of the marketing function.

You will be the key person responsible for building the marketing strategy, managing the team, and driving company growth.


Key Areas of Responsibility

Cross-functional marketing team leadership

  • Manage a team of SMM specialists, media buyers, email marketers, and content creators
  • Create clear briefs and tasks for designers and copywriters
  • Coordinate workflows between Marketing ↔ Sales ↔ Product
  • Ensure quality and timely execution across all marketing activities

Content strategy & production

  • Develop and oversee the content strategy across all channels
  • Lead the creation of client case studies (we have 100+ success stories!)
  • Adapt marketing and educational content for new markets (EU, US)
  • Maintain a consistent tone of voice and content quality

Growth & lead generation

  • Plan and host webinars and educational events
  • Launch email sequences, tripwires, and marketing funnels
  • Set up chatbot automation flows (Telegram, website)
  • Build partnerships and collaborations to scale lead generation

Analytics & optimization

  • Track channel performance, CAC, CPL, and funnel metrics
  • Calculate campaign ROI and conversion improvements
  • Optimize active campaigns to improve CAC, LTV and retention
  • Build and refine CJMs and conversion funnels

Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • Marketing team exists, but execution lacks consistency — we need a system
  • Sales launched in Europe (Finland, Germany) — marketing needs localization
  • Sales launched for English-speaking U.S. audiences — marketing must adapt
  • We have 100+ client case studies and podcast episodes ready for marketing use


Challenges you will help solve:

Content

  • No consistent content production framework
  • Client case studies are produced irregularly
  • Need adaptation for new markets
  • Content quality must be stabilized and elevated

Processes

  • Team accountability and task ownership must be improved
  • Need transparent metric tracking for optimization
  • No unified coordination between Marketing ↔ Sales

Scaling

  • Growth goal: 3× in 6 months
  • Expansion into new markets (Finland, Germany)
  • Strengthening position in the U.S.
  • Channel diversification and testing


What You Will Do

Strategy & Leadership (30%)

  • Build quarterly / monthly / weekly marketing plans
  • Manage and mentor SMM, email, and paid traffic teams
  • Write briefs and task descriptions for creatives and specialists
  • Run regular syncs with team and stakeholders
  • Prioritize initiatives and ensure deadlines are met

Content & Creative (25%)

  • Develop content strategy for SMM, email, webinars, landing pages
  • Lead the production of case studies and educational content
  • Work with designers and copywriters: briefs, quality review
  • Adapt content for different audiences and markets
  • Maintain a unified tone of voice

Lead Generation & Funnels (25%)

  • Plan and execute webinars end-to-end
  • Launch email campaigns, tripwires, and automated funnels
  • Build and optimize chatbot logic and conversion flows
  • Develop partnerships, media placements, and collaborations
  • Build CJMs and warming funnels

Analytics & Optimization (20%)

  • Analyze key metrics (CAC, CPL, conversions, ROI)
  • Produce channel and campaign performance reports
  • Optimize existing marketing activities based on data
  • Test new channels and hypotheses
  • Work with analytics tools (GA, CRM, marketing platforms)


Requirements

Must Have

Experience in EdTech or SaaS — 2+ years

  • Strong understanding of how educational/SaaS funnels work
  • B2C marketing experience in career/learning segments
  • Experience with performance metrics and ROI-oriented marketing

High-growth startup experience

  • Ability to work in a fast-changing environment
  • Skilled in prioritization and multitasking
  • Experience contributing to 2x–3x growth

Marketing team management — 1+ year

  • Ability to assign and brief tasks clearly
  • Coordination of cross-functional stakeholders
  • Delegation and performance oversight

Tools & technical marketing skills

  • Email marketing (Klaviyo, SendGrid, or similar)
  • Chatbots and automation funnels
  • Analytics (Google Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel)
  • SMM + paid advertising experience
  • Webflow / Figma / Notion for content collaboration

CJM & funnel expertise

  • Experience designing customer journey maps
  • Building content-based nurturing funnels
  • Understanding of CAC, LTV, ROMI, conversion metrics

Strong Plus

Experience running webinars and online events

Copywriting and editing skills

Knowledge of U.S./EU job markets

Experience using LinkedIn for lead generation

Background in mission-driven or social impact projects

title: Front End Engineer (Sanity)
description:
Join Our Client as a Front End Engineer (Sanity)

About the Organisation


Our Client operates within the digital technology space, delivering innovative solutions that shape the future of online experiences. Renowned for their collaborative culture and commitment to growth, they foster a dynamic environment where creativity and technical excellence thrive. Recognised for leading-edge projects and a supportive community, it's an excellent place to develop your career and make a meaningful impact.
Role Overview
 Due to an exciting expansion driven by strategic initiatives, our Client is seeking a talented Front End Engineer with expertise in SanityCMS. This role is key to enhancing their digital presence and delivering seamless user experiences. It offers a unique chance to embed yourself in innovative projects that influence global digital platforms. If you are passionate about modern front-end development and eager to push boundaries, this opportunity is perfect for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain responsive, accessible web interfaces using React and TypeScript, aligning with best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate design concepts into functional web components.
  • Integrate and optimise SanityCMS to ensure content management is efficient and user-friendly.
  • Write clean, maintainable code in HTML, CSS, and TS, ensuring optimal performance across browsers and devices.
  • Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and refining performance to uphold high-quality standards.
  • Contribute to continual improvement of development processes and technical documentation.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience building front-end applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5/CSS3 for crafting responsive and accessible layouts.
  • Hands-on experience with SanityCMS or similar headless CMS solutions.
  • Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within a team and follow clear technical guidance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail and quality.


Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Additional experience with other JavaScript frameworks or libraries.
  • Knowledge of build tools and package managers like Webpack, npm, or Yarn.
  • Understanding of SEO best practices and performance optimisation techniques.
  • Experience with agile development methodologies.
  • Knowledge of UI/UX principles and graphic design tools.


Ready to Make an Impact?


If you are excited by the prospect of developing cutting-edge digital experiences and meet the essential criteria, we encourage you to submit your CV today. Join our Client's journey to innovate and shape the future of online content delivery.

title: Tech Lead .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Atribuições:

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Organizar e acompanhar as atividades do time de desenvolvimento, promovendo alinhamento técnico e fluidez na entrega de valor.

- Supervisionar a implementação das soluções, assegurando aderência aos padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de engenharia e governança de código.

- Promover o uso de boas práticas como testes automatizados, code review, integração continua, documentação técnica e segurança desde o desenvolvimento.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Mensageria – conhecimento prático em RabbitMQ e Apache Kakfa .

- Cache e performance – uso de Redis para otimização de consultas e redução de latência.

- Bancos de dados relacionais – domínio em SQL Server , incluindo modelagem, tunning de queries e boas práticas de banco de dados.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD , testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento .

- Boa comunicação , com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

title: Microsoft MAUI Developer
description:
Job Description — Microsoft MAUI Developer

Developros is partnering with a U.S. technology team to add a Microsoft MAUI Developer who can contribute to a modern cross-platform application used by thousands of customers. This role is ideal for a self-managing engineer with strong communication skills and a product mindset. You’ll work in real time with a U.S. team, shaping both the technical direction and the user experience.


Role Overview

You will design, build, and maintain cross-platform mobile/desktop applications using .NET MAUI. The ideal candidate brings strong fundamentals in C#, architectural thinking, and an ability to collaborate closely with product and design. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and naturally contributes to team alignment and momentum.


Key Responsibilities
  • Develop high-quality mobile and desktop applications using .NET MAUI.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams in real time (EST/PST overlap).
  • Implement clean architecture, maintainable code, and scalable patterns.
  • Integrate REST APIs, authentication flows, and cloud services (Azure preferred).
  • Build UI components with a focus on performance, accessibility, and user experience.
  • Troubleshoot bugs, optimize performance, and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Participate in code reviews, sprint rituals, and product planning discussions.


Required Skills & Experience
  • 3+ years of experience with C#/.NET development.
  • Hands-on experience with MAUI, Xamarin, or other cross-platform frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of MVVM patterns and reactive architectures.
  • Experience integrating APIs and working with cloud platforms (Azure is a plus).
  • Solid understanding of mobile/desktop lifecycle, memory management, and performance optimization.
  • Comfortable working in agile environments and collaborating directly with U.S. stakeholders.
  • Strong English communication, emotional intelligence, and proactive ownership.


Nice to Have
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Background in UI/UX collaboration or component design.
  • Experience with push notifications, offline sync, or advanced mobile capabilities.
  • Familiarity with analytics tools and instrumentation.


What Makes This Opportunity Unique
  • Joining through Developros means working with a partner that prioritizes team chemistry, long-term alignment, and human-centered collaboration . Our developers operate as trusted extensions of U.S. teams — not outsourced executors. You’ll work with leaders who value initiative, clarity, and craftsmanship.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de sistemas
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.

- Liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento ágil, garantindo a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade, escaláveis e alinhadas às metas de negócio.

- Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de sistemas, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia de software, segurança da informação, automação e observabilidade.

- Atuar como facilitador entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, traduzindo necessidades estratégicas em soluções tecnológicas eficientes.

- Implementar padrões de governança técnica, versionamento, testes automatizados, CI/CD e monitoramento contínuo de performance.

- Apoiar o crescimento técnico do time por meio de mentorias, feedbacks estruturados e planos de desenvolvimento individual.

- Fomentar uma cultura de colaboração, aprendizado contínuo, inovação e melhoria constante nos processos de desenvolvimento.

- Participar ativamente de decisões estratégicas sobre tecnologias, ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento que impactem a arquitetura corporativa.

- Promover o uso racional de recursos em nuvem, garantindo eficiência operacional, segurança e sustentabilidade financeira.

- Atuar na mitigação de riscos técnicos e na resolução de incidentes críticos, com foco em análise de causa raiz e prevenção.


Requisitos e qualificações:

- Domínio técnico em:

- Arquitetura de microserviços e integração de sistemas distribuídos

- Cloud Computing (preferencialmente AWS, Azure ou GCP)

- Banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais

- Mensageria e streaming de dados (ex: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ)

- APIs RESTful, GraphQL e boas práticas de versionamento

- Ferramentas de CI/CD, containers (Docker, Kubernetes) e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)

- Forte conhecimento em metodologias Agile/Scrum/Kanban, gestão de backlog e métricas de produtividade técnica (lead time, throughput, qualidade de código).

- Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

- Certificações desejáveis: Scrum Master, AWS Solutions Architect, DevOps, Cloud Practitioner ou similares.

- Excelentes habilidades de liderança, comunicação assertiva, gestão de conflitos, visão sistêmica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

- Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de atuar estrategicamente e operacionalmente quando necessário.

- Proatividade, curiosidade tecnológica e capacidade de inspirar e engajar pessoas em torno de objetivos comuns.

title: UKG Workforce Management Analyst
description:
Position : UKG Workforce Management Analyst

Location : Brazil


We’re looking for a Senior Business Analyst (Kronos experience is required). Primarily responsible for implementing optimal Kronos solutions for customers. Key responsibilities include consultative and technical support to customers and internal teams, and delivering projects aligned with Kronos implementation methodologies. The Business Analyst is also responsible for meeting project delivery milestones and budgets.

You will work in highly complex environments, requiring complex multi-product solutions, customization and integration with other third-party products. You will also need to be highly adaptive to different customer environments and be able to independently handle discussions with senior management.

Responsibilities:

· Driving requirement assessment workshops with senior members of the customer organisation.

· Design a solution that best fits the customer requirements while limiting deviations from standard Kronos functionalities.

· Preparing functional and technical solution design documents.

· Work with the offshore technical team to build the solution and clarify their queries.

· Training core users of the customer.

· Manage customer user acceptance tests.

· Work with the project managers to align with project milestones and ensure timely billing.

Required Skills/Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a Computer Sciences or a related field.

· Experience with Kronos and UKG Workforce Management is MANDATORY.

· English Advanced (B2-C1)

· Experience in requirement gathering and solution design.

· Prior experience in supporting functional testing, integration testing, and UAT preferred.

· Demonstrated track record in delivering quality, on-time technology and business solutions to a diverse customer base.

· Solid interpersonal skills to interface with co-workers and customers.

· Ability to manage specific tasks to completion with minimal direction.

· Ability to collaborate with clients, identify engagement follow-on opportunities, and a strong desire to excel.

ASSESSOR DE INVESTIMENTOS (AAI) – ANCORD OBRIGATÓRIA | PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA | MODELO 100% REMOTO


Somos um escritório contratado do banco BTG Pactual, o maior banco de Investimentos da América Latina!


Somos focados em trazer proximidade e personalização de serviços, sempre visando melhor atender os objetivos financeiros dos nossos clientes.


Como parte dos nossos planos de expansão, estamos em busca de novos Assessores de Investimentos em todo o território nacional.


Nossa cultura organizacional valoriza a autonomia, o acompanhamento e a flexibilidade para os vinculados.


Oferecemos um modelo de trabalho completamente remoto, utilizando a tecnologia a nosso favor, a fim de promover agilidade, acessibilidade e qualidade de vida para todos os envolvidos em nossos planos de negócios!


Somos intrinsecamente vinculados ao campo da Educação, com parcerias importantes neste setor, a fim de promover aprimoramento crescente de nossos serviços e da carreira dos nossos associados.


Aqui você irá encontrar um ambiente leve e colaborativo, pois acreditamos que é esta a ética de trabalho que nos leva a qualidade e excelência em serviços financeiros!




Sobre o Cargo


  • Ofertar assessoria de investimentos personalizada, com foco na confiança e assertividade;
  • Oferecer serviços, estratégias e os melhores caminhos para atender as necessidades especificas de cada cliente;
  • Estar sempre atualizado sobre as tendências de mercado, a nível regional, nacional e internacional;
  • Realizar análises assertivas e contextualizadas com perfil do investidor;
  • Trabalhar com leads estratégicos e com a prospecção de clientes em potencial;
  • Tornar-se especialista no portfólio do BTG Pactual, produzindo os melhores resultados a nível pessoal e coletivo do escritório.



Requisitos


  • Possuir a certificação ANCORD ativa (indispensável);
  • Ter conhecimentos sobre Mercado Financeiro, Investimentos e desejo de se aprimorar;
  • Ter interesses e habilidades comerciais;
  • Ter interesse em prospectar potenciais investidores;
  • Desejar um modelo de trabalho remoto, alinhado com uma visão de negócios e identidade organizacional moderna e digital;
  • Motivação de crescer e alavancar ganhos!
  • Ser autônomo, movido por desafios e capaz de colaborar para objetivos comuns!
  • Possuir excelentes habilidades comunicacionais.



Modelo de Contratação


  • O assessor se vincula ao escritório no modelo de sociedade;
  • É articulado um percentual de repasses competitivo, passível de evolução e pensado de acordo com a bagagem do assessor;
  • Apoio no processo de transição de carreira e de entrada no mercado, contanto com acompanhamento próximo e valor de suporte (mínimo garantido mensal) com duração de 6 meses.



Etapas de Seleção


  • Entrevista com Sócios;
  • Processo de Compliance.

title: Enterprise Support Engineer
description:
About HotMic


HotMic builds AI-powered video creation workflows that help creators and media teams produce high-quality content faster and more efficiently. We operate our own platform and also work closely with large enterprise customers to deliver custom, high-impact solutions.



Role Overview


We are hiring a Senior Enterprise Support Engineer to work directly with one major enterprise customer. This is a hands-on role involving both full-stack JavaScript development and customer-facing support. You will gather requirements, develop and ship customer-specific features, resolve issues, and keep the customer updated through calls and messages. You’ll also participate in our regular engineering sprints alongside other developers and product staff.



Responsibilities


  • Develop and deliver features tailored to a large enterprise customer.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Communicate directly with the customer via calls and messages.
  • Work within engineering sprints and coordinate with internal teams.
  • Maintain clear, fluent English communication.



Requirements


  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Senior-level full-stack JavaScript experience.
  • Experience working in structured team sprints.
  • Background working with enterprise customers or complex implementations.
  • Comfortable in a mixed engineering + support role.
  • Strong teamwork and ability to work independently.

title: Full Stack Software Developer "#985259"
description:
Quem Somos

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Quality Control Lead
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a structured, strict, and technically-minded Head of Quality Assurance who will build and lead one of the most critical operational units in the company.

Scope of responsibility:

  • Management of a team of 30+ remote assistants
  • Quality control of 5,000+ job applications/month (scaling to 10,000+)
  • Direct reporting to the CEO


Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • 30 assistants submit job applications on behalf of clients
  • Quality is inconsistent—there is no systematic control
  • Many manual review processes → we need automation
  • No structured onboarding for new assistants
  • No clear KPIs or performance-based motivation


What must be built:

Audit the current team

Hire additional assistants

Build a full Quality Assurance system from scratch

Automate quality checks in collaboration with engineering

Implement onboarding, training, and control processes


Key Responsibilities

Build a Quality Assurance system (30%)

First 2 weeks:

  • Audit current assistants
  • Evaluate work quality (accuracy, speed, compliance)
  • Decide who stays, who leaves
  • Create quality criteria and checklists

Ongoing:

  • Implement regular quality audits and spot-checks
  • Establish KPIs (quality, speed, customer satisfaction)
  • Track quality metrics per assistant
  • Identify repeating errors and remove root causes
  • Review difficult cases with the team

Hiring & Onboarding (25%)

Hiring:

  • Design the hiring funnel (screening → test task → interview)
  • Hire new assistants within first 1–2 months
  • Maintain a candidate pipeline (no current churn, but may appear)

Onboarding & training:

  • Build a structured onboarding program (1–2 weeks)
  • Teach systems, standards, and workflows
  • Certify assistants before they start working with clients
  • Create training materials, videos, guides

Automation & Technology (20%)

Work with engineering team:

  • Identify which checks can be automated
  • Create clear requirements and tasks for developers
  • Test and launch automation tools
  • Utilize AI and scripts for monitoring

Automation examples:

  • Automatic validation of application fields
  • Duplicate application detection
  • Performance dashboards and speed tracking
  • Quality alert system
  • Real-time monitoring tools

Team Management (15%)

  • Workload distribution among assistants
  • KPI tracking and performance reviews
  • Escalation handling and issue resolution
  • Motivation and team culture development

People development:

  • Selective 1:1s
  • Coaching low performers
  • Promote top performers into team leads
  • Create internal career paths

Continuous improvement (10%)

  • Identify bottlenecks and improve processes
  • Implement best practices and standardization
  • Maintain operations documentation
  • Work with client complaints, root cause elimination

Requirements

Must-Have:

2+ years managing operational teams

  • Experience managing 20+ employees
  • Built processes from scratch
  • Preferably BPO/outsourcing/call center/EdTech

Strong systems thinking and discipline

  • SOPs, checklists, regulations, compliance
  • Precision and attention to detail
  • Ability to make difficult decisions (terminations, corrective action)

Technical competency

  • Understanding of automation & quality monitoring
  • Ability to write clear requirements for developers
  • Experience with CRM, monitoring dashboards, etc.
  • Nice-to-have: SQL basics, API logic, scripting

Analytical approach

  • Metrics: quality %, speed, productivity, error rate
  • KPI systems and reporting
  • Data-driven decision-making

Experience in hiring & onboarding


Strong Plus:

BPO/outsourcing experience (data entry, support, back office)

Quality automation experience

Technical degree (engineering / CS / math)

Six Sigma/Lean/Kaizen knowledge

Experience scaling teams from 10 → 50+

QA/Quality Management certifications

Experience with distributed remote teams

In this role, you will take ownership of end-to-end testing strategies, leveraging Python for comprehensive test automation across functional, non-functional, and white-box testing. You will also play a key role in maintaining monitoring systems to proactively identify issues in production environments.


Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Framework Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable end-to-end (E2E) tests using Python, Playwright, and Pytest for both UI and API validation.
  • Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) to support continuous delivery and provide fast feedback.
  • Implement and manage test data and environments to ensure reliable and repeatable test execution.

Test Planning & Strategy

  • Design, document, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define quality benchmarks and ensure test coverage for all requirements.

Functional and Non-Functional Testing

  • Execute detailed automated and manual tests across multiple platforms and devices to validate functionality, usability, and performance.
  • Ensure that systems meet reliability, scalability, and availability expectations, especially in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) .

White-box Testing

  • Work closely with developers to understand internal logic and architecture, enabling more effective code-level testing.
  • Utilize Python scripts to facilitate unit, integration, and service-level testing beyond traditional black-box methods.

Monitoring System Configuration

  • Manage application and infrastructure monitoring tools.
  • Establish alerts and dashboards to support proactive issue resolution and maintain uptime.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing.
  • 3+ years of proficiency in Python for test automation, scripting, and framework development.
  • Demonstrable experience with modern testing frameworks/tools like Playwright and Pytest for effective and reliable E2E and API testing.
  • Proven experience working with and testing applications deployed in a Cloud Environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) .
  • Solid experience setting up and maintaining test execution within CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) .
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Good knowledge of SQL is a must.
  • Familiarity with modern monitoring platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Datadog, or similar).
  • Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.


Nice to have

  • Proficiency in performance and security testing tools (e.g., JMeter, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite).
  • Experience in testing data pipelines or data warehouse solutions , particularly Amazon Redshift .
  • Familiarity with testing applications built on AI/ML platforms , such as AWS Bedrock (e.g., prompt validation, knowledge base testing, or guardrail evaluation).


What We Offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer (Flutter, C#/.NET)
description:
Company Description

US based health technology company to be disclosed during the interview process.


Role Description

We are seeking a Full Stack Mobile Developer  to join our team and take ownership of our health monitoring mobile application. This application integrates with a Bluetooth-enabled ring pulse oximeter to collect health data throughout the night. 


The ideal candidate will be a hands-on developer with expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile flagship application using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address mobile battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Introduce in app features to provide payments, notifications, and support (chat)
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Qualifications

  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level), both written and spoken.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with mobile battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Familiarity with in-app payment systems (such as Authorize.net, Stripe)
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus.

description:
Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori para atuar em projetos estratégicos de modernização e evolução tecnológica no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) .

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções modernas utilizando ABAP Cloud e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 , aplicando boas práticas de clean core e arquitetura extensível.

Além das iniciativas mais modernas, é importante que o profissional possua base sólida em ABAP Clássico , garantindo flexibilidade para atuar em demandas tradicionais quando necessário.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e extensões com ABAP Cloud / RAP integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 .
  • Implementar e manter serviços OData, CDS Views e AMDPs para consumo em interfaces Fiori.
  • Trabalhar em ambiente SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP , aplicando conceitos de clean core e extensibilidade .

  • Garantir performance, segurança e qualidade de código nas entregas.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento ABAP , com domínio de ABAP Clássico e ABAP Cloud .
  • Experiência sólida com RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) .
  • Domínio de SAP Fiori / SAP UI5 e Fiori Elements .
  • Conhecimento em CDS Views , OData Services , AMDPs e integrações RESTful .
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento (Eclipse ADT, Git, transportes em BTP ).

title: Talent Manager
description:
About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Talent Manager to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfilment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfilment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Conduct talent pool assessments and identify supply-demand gaps.
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfilment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfilment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve internal talent fulfilment processes and introduce best practices.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7–12 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Experience handling multiple simultaneous delivery pipelines and managing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter(good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfilment.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or reporting dashboards.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.
  • Understanding of internal mobility, workforce planning, or project-based staffing models.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Analista de rede
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Administração de redes Wi-Fi : configuração e suporte em controladoras Cisco (WLC 25XX, 35XX, 55XX, 98XX); criação e manutenção de SSIDs com autenticação MAC, 802.1X, Portal Guest (ISE), e APs em modo Local/Flexconnect.

Segurança da informação : sustentação de firewalls Palo Alto, Cisco ASA (FTD-Standalone) e Firepower + FMC; criação e revisão de regras, URL Filtering, Application Control, gestão de VPNs (Client-to-Site – Global Protect) e ambientes em HA.

Infraestrutura LAN : configuração de switches Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX), VLANs, interfaces trunk/acesso e políticas de port-security.

Conectividade WAN : operação e monitoração de ambientes SD-WAN (Aruba SilverPeak), aplicando conceitos de alta disponibilidade e otimização de tráfego.

Monitoramento proativo : administração da ferramenta SolarWinds (nodes, alertas, tuning de monitoramento).

Relacionamento com vendors : abertura e gestão de chamados junto a TAC Cisco e Palo Alto, acompanhamento de incidentes críticos e processos de RMA.

Documentação e melhoria contínua : elaboração de procedimentos técnicos, relatórios de incidentes e recomendações de boas práticas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Computação, Redes, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas ;

Experiência prática em suporte e sustentação de redes corporativas de grande porte ;

Domínio em Cisco Wireless (WLC) e Switching Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX) ;

Experiência sólida em Firewall Palo Alto e Cisco Firepower/ASA ;

Conhecimento em VPNs, URL Filtering, HA e Application Policies ;

Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento SolarWinds ;

Imprescindível Inglês avançado.


Atuação Remota em escala 12x36 das 07 às 19h


Informações adicionais

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: PS Systems Engineer
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.


This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
  • Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
  • Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
  • Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
  • Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.


Skills & Experience

  • 3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
  • 3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
  • Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
  • Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
  • Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
  • Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.


This is a fully remote position, on a B2B contract basis, paying up to USD20 per hour

title: Backend Developer  - Pleno
description:
Backend Developer - Pleno


Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to understand requirements for ML/LLM features. Design, implement, maintain, improve, and document backend systems (Python, FastAPI) for ML/LLM features. Manage and optimize databases (Postgres, MongoDB, Milvus) for application storage. Improve observability and reliability for distributed, async workloads (structured logging, metrics, retry/backoff strategies, traces). Help maintain and orchestrate containerized development workflows (uv, Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes) and CI checks. Raise the bar for testing (unit + integration) to ensure high code quality and reliability. Improve the local development experience for the team by establishing and promoting Python-based development standards and best practices. Integrate and optimize calls to LLM APIs (OpenAI) and agentic frameworks (OpenAI Agents SDK). Mentor other engineers and drive architectural decisions.


Requirements


  • Experience in backend engineering, specifically in building production services, with over 2 years of expertise in working with asynchronous Python.
  • Extensive Python knowledge: async/await, typing system, modern Pydantic (v2), and testing frameworks (pytest).
  • Production experience building RESTful APIs with FastAPI and ASGI servers (uvicorn).
  • Solid operational and debugging skills for async systems and distributed services.
  • Strong familiarity with Postgres and MongoDB databases.
  • Experience with vector search systems (Milvus, FAISS, Pinecone) and embedding pipelines.
  • Experience with message queues, background processing, and patterns for batch processing, idempotency, and retries.
  • Practical experience integrating with OpenAI or other LLM providers.
  • Comfortable working with containerization technologies (Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with AWS services (EKS, ECS, S3).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote team environment.
  • Good English proficiency (reading, writing, speaking).

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

  • Analisar, planejar e executar desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa;
  • Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica;
  • Construir modelos funcionais e de dados de sistemas, aplicando boas práticas que garantam visão estruturada, qualidade, reutilização, facilidade de manutenção de códigos;
  • Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, por meio de conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções;
  • Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Apoio a criação do plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Avaliar e elaborar a documentação técnica dos sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos, de forma suficiente à posterior compreensão da atividade executada;
  • Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções.
  • Cumprir as diretrizes de segurança da informação estabelecidas pelo Grupo Imagem.
  • Desenvolver os trabalhos de depuração e testes de programa, executando serviços de manutenção nos programas já existentes identificando as causas de erros e realizar as correções necessárias a fim de obter os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos;
  • Receber a especificação funcional para desenvolvimento, melhoria e manutenção de softwares, avaliar e estimar o tempo necessário para execução de acordo com o previsto na proposta técnica;
  • Realizar testes básicos da codificação efetuada, de acordo com as instruções contidas na especificação, de forma a minimizar a propagação de erros para a fase de testes;
  • Entender e discutir a estratégia de codificação com o Especialista e/ou Analista da equipe e codificar a solução de software necessária para atender o recurso definido para o produto seguindo as diretrizes, políticas e estratégias da empresa;
  • Apoiar na realização de testes automatizados, unidade, integração, desempenho etc.
  • Aplicar procedimentos definidos no Processo de Desenvolvimento, com base nas especificações detalhadas das funcionalidades a serem criadas no projeto;
  • Transformar requisitos em um sistema pronto, bem como realizar as fases de elaboração de requisitos e da programação de sistemas; Conhecer tecnicamente as fases das atividades, identificar e orientar a solução de problemas;
  • Utilizar a ferramenta e os procedimentos estabelecidos no Processo de Desenvolvimento da empresa para reportar problemas encontrados, indicar o progresso das suas atividades, apontar horas trabalhadas e demais informações aplicáveis;
  • Contribuir na estimativa de novas funcionalidades e na avaliação do impacto de novos requisitos a projetos, com relação à complexidade e viabilidade do esforço da implementação desenvolvida.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de negócio com o objetivo de desenhar e desenvolver;
  • Entender, criar, manipular e consultar bancos de dados visando a execução das etapas de desenvolvimento do programa;
  • Corrigir e propor melhorias em bugs, bem como desenvolver novas funcionalidades para os sistemas propondo soluções/melhorias e realizar a implantação das funcionalidades em ambientes;
  • Definir soluções técnicas de acordo com a tecnologia utilizada nos projetos em desenvolvimento, através da produção de código limpo e eficiente;
  • Participar do sprint para elaboração do plano de trabalho e distribuição das atividades, bem como programar, implementar e manter rotinas;
  • Alinhar com o gestor a demanda, funcionalidades e aplicação nas operações de desenvolvimento;
