description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional sênior para atuar com Governança e Segurança da Informação, liderando projetos estratégicos que envolvem arquitetura, governança, proteção e integração de dados corporativos. Se você tem perfil analítico, visão sistêmica e paixão por ambientes inovadores, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, implementar e manter arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e aderentes às necessidades do negócio.
  • Liderar iniciativas de governança de dados, incluindo definição de políticas, classificação, qualidade, controle de acesso e rastreabilidade.
  • Definir e aplicar políticas de segurança da informação, privacidade e compliance (LGPD, GDPR), garantindo alinhamento com práticas de governança.
  • Realizar modelagem de dados (relacional, dimensional e big data), assegurando integridade, disponibilidade e consistência.
  • Desenvolver e monitorar pipelines de ETL/ELT, integrando dados de múltiplas fontes com foco em qualidade e conformidade.
  • Implementar controles de segurança em ambientes cloud e on-premises (Azure, AWS, GCP), priorizando governança e gestão de riscos.
  • Conduzir análises de risco e auditorias, com abordagem orientada à melhoria contínua.
  • Colaborar com times de TI, negócios e compliance para garantir alinhamento entre arquitetura, governança e requisitos regulatórios.
  • Promover automação de processos, monitoramento contínuo e evolução das práticas de governança e arquitetura.

title: SAP SAC Developer
description:
Required Skills & Experience


- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent experience. - 5+ years of experience in SAP Analytics Cloud with a strong focus on Planning. - Proven track record in SAC Planning model design, data actions, and advanced formulas. - Hands-on experience with integration to SAP ERP systems. - Strong understanding of financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes. - Proficiency in data modeling, scripting, and performance tuning within SAC. - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise-grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast-moving development environments.


What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company-wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization-wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company-wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.


Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud-native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI/CD pipelines — automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure-by-design implementation in infrastructure-as-code and deployments.


Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi-region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.


Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.


Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in written and spoken English


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Iteration Video Editor
description:
Who We Are

Mindful Agency is a performance-driven creative team specializing in high-converting Meta ads for top tech brands. We’re looking for an Iterations Editor—someone who can take fully edited 30–60 second Meta ads and generate multiple high-quality variations designed to increase performance, improve hook testing, and expand creative volume.


This role is not standard editing. It requires someone who understands creative iteration as a scientific process: isolating variables, modifying structure and pacing, and generating new variants that give Meta’s algorithm more opportunities to find winners.


What You’ll Do
  • Open existing fully-edited Premiere Pro project files and generate new, distinct iterations of the same ad.
  • Create alternative hooks, shorten or re-structure timelines, adjust pacing, and introduce new punch-in/out moments to increase stopping power.
  • Modify captions, layout, on-screen text, reframing, b-roll timing, and transitions while keeping brand consistency intact.
  • Produce multiple versions of each ad optimized for performance testing (length trims, hook variations, CTA variations).
  • Ensure all variations are export-ready, cleanly organized, and aligned with Mindful Agency’s internal workflow in Notion and Google Drive.
  • Collaborate asynchronously with the creative team to understand each ad’s strategic goal (problem-solution, testimonial, UGC pacing, value prop emphasis).
  • Maintain consistent daily output based on clear production expectations and deliverables.


Requirements
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (must be comfortable navigating another editor’s timeline, proxies, nests, captions, and media management).
  • Strong understanding of direct-response video editing, ideally with experience in Meta/TikTok ad formats.
  • Ability to identify and modify high-leverage creative variables: hook strength, pacing, text placement, dynamic framing, and overall watch-through optimization.
  • Strong creative instincts paired with a scientific mindset—able to think in terms of tests, variants, and performance hypotheses.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to produce clean, organized sequences that integrate back into our workflow.
  • Fast, reliable communication and ability to work independently across global time zones.
  • Portfolio demonstrating short-form ads or UGC-style edits (required).


Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience with direct-response brands, SaaS, tech, or e-commerce.
  • Familiarity with Meta ad performance patterns (retention curves, thumb-stop theory, hook testing).
  • Motion graphics or caption stylization skills for added variation when needed.


Why Work With Mindful
  • Work with a fast-growing US-based performance agency that values craftsmanship and creativity.
  • Clear workflows, predictable task structure, and objective editing metrics.
  • Long-term opportunity with consistent volume of work.

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a delivery fulfillment platform designed specifically to support local businesses. We help these businesses manage their deliveries efficiently by connecting them with skilled drivers tailored to meet their delivery needs. Additionally, we provide essential tools for logistical, financial, and marketing support, empowering local food and beverage makers to expand their businesses


Role of the QA Team:

Our QA team is crucial in ensuring the quality of our platform. There are two main tasks you will focus on:

  • Bug Analysis: Understand and diagnose bugs that make it into production. This requires a solid understanding of our product and excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Proactively finding issues that affect users: Identify parts of the system that need to be improved according to feedback coming from users and testing. You need to be able to clearly report the problem and propose a solution.
  • Feature Verification: Manually check whether new features work as intended. This involves strong analytical skills to assess user experience and interface design.


While specific technical skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code, and creating automated tests are very beneficial, they are not required.


We're looking for candidates with strong English, product analysis skills, and excellent communication. This is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday position, with working hours from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (Boston time), including a one-hour lunch break.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Application Portfolio Management (APM) Engineer to support our enterprise architecture and application rationalization efforts using LeanIX. This role is critical in capturing, analyzing, and maintaining application metadata to assess current technology usage, align future business requirements, and guide decisions on modernization, consolidation, or new application development. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote India or Brazil.


Why This Role Matters:

This role directly supports our enterprise-wide transformation by enabling smarter technology investments, reducing redundancy, and aligning IT capabilities with business strategy. You’ll play a key role in shaping our future application landscape.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

LeanIX Data Stewardship

  • Populate and maintain accurate application data within LeanIX, including ownership, lifecycle, business capabilities, and technical attributes.
  • Ensure completeness and consistency of metadata across the application portfolio.


Application Rationalization

  • Evaluate applications for business value (e.g., strategic alignment, user impact, cost efficiency).
  • Assess technical value (e.g., scalability, integration readiness, security posture, supportability).
  • Identify candidates for retirement, consolidation, or modernization.


Technology Mapping & Future Planning

  • Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to map future business requirements to existing technologies.
  • Support decision-making on whether to enhance current platforms or build new applications.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with application owners, enterprise architects, and business analysts to gather insights and validate data.
  • Facilitate workshops and reviews to ensure alignment on application strategy and lifecycle decisions.


Reporting & Insights

  • Generate dashboards and reports from LeanIX to support executive decision-making.
  • Provide insights into portfolio health, redundancy, risk, and optimization opportunities.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • 3+ years of experience in application portfolio management, enterprise architecture, or IT asset management.
  • Hands-on experience with LeanIX or similar APM tools.
  • Strong understanding of application lifecycle, business capability modeling, and technology stack analysis.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, BIZBOK) is required.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-15% travel as per business requirements.

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
About Specialty Capital

Specialty Capital was founded just four years ago with a bold idea - to give “debanked” small businesses access to capital that’s Simple, Smart, and Reliable. Today, the company is among the top revenue-based finance companies in the U.S., serving thousands of merchants through a combination of speed, technology, and a deeply human approach. We’re now entering our next chapter and scaling into new financial verticals (credit cards, payments, and neo-bank integrations) and expanding internationally, starting with Canada. The company is profitable, founder-led, and growing rapidly with a culture built on grit, ownership, and mission.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Design and evolve the comprehensive technical architecture for our lending platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Define and maintain architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across all technology initiatives
  • Lead technology selection and evaluation processes for new tools, frameworks, and platforms
  • Create technical roadmaps aligned with business objectives and product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams

Mobile Application Architecture

  • Architect and oversee the development of native mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms
  • Design mobile solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences for loan applications and account management
  • Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services
  • Optimize mobile application performance and offline capabilities


Platform Development

  • Collaborate with SaaS vendors to ensure platform configurations align with architectural standards
  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes


Security & Compliance

  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies
  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures


Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical expertise in node.js, React, Swift, Java/Kotlin development
  • Review code, architectures, and technical designs to ensure quality and standards
  • Facilitate technical discussions and decision-making across teams
  • Establish development standards, coding practices, and documentation requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and technical practices

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; Master's degree preferred
  • 10-15 years of progressive experience in software architecture and development
  • Required: Extensive experience in mobile application development for iOS and Android platforms
  • Strong expertise in Swift for iOS and Java/Kotlin for Android development
  • Proven experience with financial technology platforms and payment systems
  • Deep knowledge of cloud architecture
  • Experience with node.js, React, mySQL, and modern web technologies
  • Strong background in API design, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, and reporting solutions
  • Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and financial services regulations
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in small business lending or commercial finance
  • Experience with Large Language Models / ML implementations in financial services
  • Knowledge of loan origination systems and credit decisioning platforms
  • Experience with React Native or cross-platform mobile development frameworks

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible working arrangements
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of a growing fintech company
  • Professional development opportunities and conference attendance
  • Collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and impact

Join Specialty Capital and play a pivotal role in revolutionizing small business lending through innovative technology solutions. As our Technical Architect, you'll have the opportunity to design systems that directly impact thousands of businesses across the country, helping them access the capital they need to grow and thrive.

Specialty Capital is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Casting Coordinator
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works.


About Our Search

We are currently looking for a Casting Coordinator to join our client, a global content company with a focus on talent sourcing for dynamic content projects.


What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in casting, story production, or talent interviewing.
  • Strong communication skills in English.
  • Proficiency with various casting resources and familiarity with social media platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Twitch.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to work efficiently under tight deadlines.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and capable of handling multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Positive attitude with flexibility to adapt to last-minute changes and cancellations.
  • Experience with casting databases and familiarity with Monday.com and Google Suite.


What will you do?

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to talent sourcing and casting across innovative content projects.


  • Identify and source emerging talent across social media platforms, staying on top of trends.
  • Post-casting calls aligned with creative outlines for new and ongoing productions.
  • Screen, organize, and categorize auditions, preparing submissions for producer review.
  • Coordinate auditions with talent, agencies, and managers, managing the talent booking process.
  • Maintain a robust casting database with accurate records and updated talent profiles.
  • Collaborate with Performance Managers to validate profiles, negotiate terms, and align schedules.
  • Produce and direct assigned content episodes, ensuring alignment with strategy, budget, and creative goals.
  • Hosting the episodes on Youtube, being on camera as an interviewer.
  • Build strong relationships with the talent to foster positive creative collaborations and ensure smooth productions.
  • Track deadlines, legal requirements, and production specifications for timely and cost-effective delivery.


Are you ready to make an impact in content creation? Apply now with your English CV !

  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA (desejável).
  • Ingles: avançado
  • Espanhol: intermediário/avançado

  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills

O(a) profissional será responsável por transformar requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas de alto desempenho, garantindo qualidade, segurança e aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

Conhecimentos e Competências Técnicas

  • VB6 – manutenção e integração de sistemas legados.
  • Microsserviços e APIs REST – design, implementação e integração de serviços distribuídos.
  • Banco de Dados Relacional – modelagem e otimização de consultas SQL.
  • Conhecimento em Java – diferencial desejável para atuação em ambientes híbridos de tecnologia.
  • Metodologias Ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) – experiência em projetos colaborativos e entregas iterativas.
  • Ambientes Financeiros – desejável vivência em instituições financeiras ou projetos bancários.


Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Boa comunicação e postura profissional em interações com clientes exigentes.
  • Resiliência e inteligência emocional para lidar com situações de pressão e cobrança.
  • Capacidade de defender ideias de forma assertiva, mantendo empatia e respeito.
  • Proatividade e adaptabilidade diante de mudanças.
  • Organização e autodesenvolvimento constante.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal e colaboração em equipe.
  • Confiabilidade e foco em resultados.


Formação Acadêmica

  • Curso superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação na área de TI será considerada um diferencial.


Experiência Profissional

  • Mínimo de 6 anos de experiência atuando com .Net, VB6, APIs REST e microsserviços .
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade e ambientes corporativos exigentes.


Outras Informações

  • Licenças e ferramentas diferenciadas: máquina fornecida pelo cliente.
  • Ambiente dinâmico e desafiador , com possibilidade de atuação em múltiplos projetos estratégicos.

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno
description:
Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

O Desenvolvedor Pleno é um profissional multi-skill, com olhar para o design digital e com experiência nos elementos de experiência do usuário e acessibilidade. O foco principal do trabalho será em projetos de baixa complexidade, atuando com desenvolvimento de aplicações IVA, no Veeva, programação de banners animados HTML/CSS, com o GWD e e-mails marketing , mas também incluirá edição de conteúdo de websites, uso de webapps de terceiros e estruturas de programas para o iPad. Espera-se que você forneça suporte às equipes de desenvolvimento sênior na codificação, atualize o código existente com pedidos de mudança de conteúdo e auxilie na depuração de problemas logados pelo time de QA. Haverá o uso diário de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD e Photoshop (assim como de outros programas do Adobe Creative Suite). Você deverá estar familiarizado com estes programas e se sentir confortável em usá-los para visualizar layouts e exportar imagens.


Responsabilidades:

• Domínio da plataforma Veeva para o desenvolvimento e manutenção em IVAs.

• Programação de banners e emails (formatos iniciais e ajustes de materiais já existentes);

• Elaboração de screenshots (para os quais terá um treinamento por parte da empresa);

• Entendimento dos pedidos e instruções em inglês nos documentos marcados e implementar as mudanças solicitadas;

• Participar de scrums internos e/ou planejamento de projetos;

• Traduzir projetos criativos para um código limpo e livre de erros que se alinhe às melhores práticas do Studio Rx;

• Assegurar que os pedidos de trabalho sejam concluídos com qualidade e no tempo estabelecido;

• Obter e manter as certificações exigidas, conforme identificadas pela equipe de Operações.


Requerimentos & Skills:

• Bacharelado em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;

• 4-6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento com proficiência em desenvolvimento web de front-end (padrões web HTML5);

• Certificação Veeva para desenvolvimento de IVAs;

• Experiência com animações CSS, transições e uso de key frame;

• Experiência com estruturas Javascript ou JS (Jquery, Angular, Node);

• Experiência com Git, Azure, SVN, ou sistemas de controle de versões similares;

• Uso do Adobe Creative Suite (Figma, XD e Photoshop);

• Familiaridade com HTML 5 e Web Standards, SEO, Acessibilidade, desenvolvimento de e-mails visando à compatibilidade cross-browser/cross-platform, javascript e algum framework (React, Angular, Vue, Next);

• Uso de ferramentas para emular dispositivos móveis e sistemas operacionais (BrowserStack, E-mail on Acid);

• Familiarizado com dispositivos tablet (Android, iPad) e smartphones;

• Inglês Avançado (foco em leitura, interpretação de texto e escrita).


Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

description:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Electrical BIM Modeler
description:
Now Hiring: Electrical BIM Modeler

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Engagement Type: Full-Time

Work Format: Work From Home


Note: Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume in English.


At Eracore , we bring innovation and precision to the forefront of electrical construction through advanced BIM modeling. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Backed by a dynamic team of 40+ talented modelers and engineers, Eracore is more than just a workplace its a launchpad for ambitious professionals. We collaborate with top-tier electrical contractors nationwide, offering unparalleled exposure, hands-on experience, and real opportunities for career advancement.


If you're ready to work on game-changing projects, grow alongside a fast-rising company, and be part of shaping the future of electrical construction, Eracore is where your next chapter begins.


Join us and shape the future of the construction industry!


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a BIM/VDC Specialist at Eracore . The Electrical BIM Modeler will be responsible for creating 3D models and shop drawings to provide clarity and precision during field installations. The role involves utilizing BIM software for visualization and validation of electrical installations.


Qualifications

  • 4-7 Years of Experience with Revit
  • Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Construction Drawings skills
  • Experience with Prefabrication Spool Drawings
  • Experience in working with Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) systems
  • Proficiency in Architecture and Modeler software
  • Knowledge of electrical design principles and calculations
  • Ability to interpret and create single line diagrams
  • Experience in load calculations and voltage drop evaluations
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

Modelo: 100% remoto

Fuso horário: Costa Oeste dos EUA (PST)

NECESSÁRIO INGLÊS FLUENTE!


A Stefanini LATAM está em busca de um(a) Gerente de Projetos SAP AMS para atuar em nossos projetos internacionais, apoiando a Diretoria de SAP na gestão e entrega de serviços de suporte e melhorias contínuas em ambientes SAP ECC e S/4HANA .

Este(a) profissional será responsável por planejar, coordenar e monitorar as atividades de AMS (Application Management Services) , garantindo o cumprimento de prazos, escopo, custos e níveis de serviço acordados (SLAs). Atuará como ponto focal entre clientes, equipes internas e parceiros externos , assegurando qualidade nas entregas e valor agregado ao negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de suporte e projetos de melhorias SAP (AMS) , incluindo escopo, cronograma, orçamento e riscos.
  • Coordenar múltiplas iniciativas de pequenas e médias melhorias (enhancements) simultaneamente.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance (SLA, backlog, tempo médio de resolução) e propor ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Facilitar reuniões operacionais e executivas com clientes e equipes AMS.
  • Apoiar análises de causa raiz e planos de correção para incidentes recorrentes.
  • Garantir conformidade com processos de change management, ITIL e SAP Solution Manager/ChaRM .
  • Supervisionar contratos AMS, validando esforços, custos e relatórios mensais.
  • Coordenar times distribuídos (Brasil, Índia, EUA) e manter comunicação fluente em inglês.


Requisitos

  • 8 a 10 anos de experiência em TI , com pelo menos 3 anos em gestão de projetos ou operações SAP AMS .
  • Experiência em múltiplos módulos SAP (ex: FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, QM, BW, SuccessFactors, etc.).
  • Vivência com metodologias SAP Activate, ASAP ou Agile (Scrum/Kanban) .
  • Conhecimento de ITSM e ITIL v4 ; certificação ITIL é um diferencial.
  • Experiência com SAP Solution Manager, JIRA ou Azure DevOps .
  • Inglês fluente (comunicação diária com stakeholders globais).
  • Espanhol será considerado um diferencial.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no fuso horário do Pacífico (Califórnia) .

Diferenciais

  • Certificações PMP, PRINCE2, SAP Activate ou equivalente.
  • Experiência prévia em empresas globais de consultoria ou clientes multinacionais .
  • Habilidade em liderar equipes remotas e multiculturais .

  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field

  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.

  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Atuamos em parceria com uma empresa multinacional de grande porte do setor industrial , referência em inovação, sustentabilidade e gestão responsável. Buscamos um Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori para atuação temporária até dezembro , com possibilidade de prorrogação .

O profissional participará de projetos e melhorias no módulo SAP SRH (HCM) , com foco em Benefícios (Benefits) , sendo responsável por desenvolver, customizar e manter aplicações Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP , garantindo performance, segurança e excelente experiência do usuário .


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar, adaptar ou estender aplicações SAP Fiori;
  • Atuar com codificação e arquitetura de soluções;
  • Desenvolver e customizar aplicativos SAP Fiori/UI5 voltados a processos de benefícios (adesão, consulta, alteração e cancelamento);
  • Criar e consumir serviços OData via SAP Gateway , integrando as aplicações Fiori aos dados do SRH;
  • Colaborar com consultores funcionais de RH para entendimento das regras de negócio (ex.: infotypes 0167, 0168, 0171);
  • Implementar extensões em aplicativos padrão SAP Fiori (“Meus Benefícios”, “Gerenciar Benefícios”);
  • Garantir conformidade com as diretrizes de UX/UI do SAP Fiori Design Guidelines ;
  • Realizar testes técnicos e funcionais , assegurando performance e segurança dos dados;
  • Publicar e gerenciar aplicativos no Fiori Launchpad (catálogos, grupos e roles);
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planning, review, retrospectiva) em conjunto com times funcionais, ABAP e de infraestrutura.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP Fiori e SAPUI5 (HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, XML, controllers, models);
  • Domínio em OData Services (criação, consumo e troubleshooting);
  • Conhecimento em ABAP OO para suporte às integrações com SRH;
  • Vivência com SAP Gateway (SEGW) e configuração de serviços;
  • Experiência com Fiori Launchpad , perfis de acesso (PFCG) e transportes SAP;
  • Domínio das ferramentas SAP Web IDE ou Business Application Studio (BAS) ;
  • Entendimento básico de Fiori Elements, Smart Controls e Theme Designer ;
  • Capacidade de análise de logs e resolução de incidentes em ambiente produtivo.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento dos processos funcionais de Benefícios (BEN) dentro do SRH (planos de saúde, previdência, dependentes, reembolsos);
  • Entendimento dos infotypes 0167, 0168, 0170, 0171 ;
  • Experiência em extensão de aplicativos padrão SAP ;
  • Familiaridade com DevOps, Git, CI/CD e metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban );
  • Conhecimento em SAP BTP , CAP ou desenvolvimento em ambientes cloud .



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Recruiting Operations Manager
description:
Company Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a US national healthcare recruiting firm that focuses on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.


We are hiring a Recruiting Operations Manager to work directly with the CEO. This person will take ideas, conversations, and action items and turn them into completed projects. The right candidate will be the operational backbone of the recruiting process, ensuring accuracy, follow-through, and consistent momentum.


If you are organized, resourceful, and skilled at turning plans into results, this role is for you.


About the CEO and the Role

Max McNamara is the CEO of Full Spectrum Search Group. With over 13 years of search experience and a degree in Technological Entrepreneurship and Management, Max combines hands-on recruiting expertise with a strong focus on systems, process, and performance. He has also served as a coach and workflow automation consultant for one of the largest recruiting firm networks in the world, helping build smarter infrastructure and scalable operations across multiple search organizations.


Max is a visionary who thrives on ideas, relationships, and growth. He’s looking for an Integrator who can bring structure, accountability, and follow-through. This role is both strategic and tactical. You’ll be a true operational partner and someone who keeps the recruiting engine running smoothly, ensures every opportunity moves from conversation to completion, and turns ideas into measurable results.


Recruiting Operations and Workflow Management

  • Attend client, candidate, and internal meetings and own the post-meeting follow-through by ensuring every conversation leads to completed next steps
  • Manage all recruiting activity in Crelate (CRM) including job orders, candidate pipelines, and client updates.
  • Keep data clean, organized, syndicated, and current across LinkedIn RPS, Crelate, and lead spreadsheets.
  • Ensure all searches are actively moving forward and nothing sits idle.
  • Create weekly progress summaries and present during weekly team meetings


Process Improvement & Automation

  • Strong emphasis on workflow automation and continually looking for relevant and savvy ways to make things more efficient, eliminate bottle necks, etc.
  • Proactively look for areas to improve process and workflows and suggest edits
  • Become the subject matter on industry tools and technologies that can lead to better results over time.


Team Coordination and Communication

  • Collaborate with internal team members to keep projects on track and deadlines met.
  • Draft clear, professional recap messages after client and candidate calls.
  • Coordinate and manage the CEO’s calendar for efficiency and balance.
  • Follow up with recruiters and support staff to make sure deliverables are completed and priorities stay aligned.


Research, Marketing, and Deliverables

  • Research operators, facilities, and leadership teams using internal templates and data sources.
  • Maintain and update tracking lists for sourcing, outreach, and facility-level research.
  • Format and proofread MPC write-ups, job descriptions, and client submissions using company templates and tone.
  • Support marketing activities including LinkedIn posts and client-facing materials to ensure brand consistency.


What You’ll Bring

  • Excellent written and spoken English suitable for professional U.S. business communication.
  • Understanding of American business culture and communication style.
  • Experience working with US-based companies in operations and/or account/project management support.
  • Strong technology background.
  • Experience using AI to increase efficiency and automation.
  • Strong organization and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects.
  • Proficiency with CRM’s, LinkedIn, Google Sheets, and ChatGPT or similar tools.
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate needs and take ownership.
  • A professional home office setup suitable for professional video calls with executives.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and consistent availability during U.S. business hours with Central Time schedule.


Ideal Background

  • Three to five years of experience in operations or project management roles.
  • Longevity on your resume with the ability to articulate your success in similar roles.
  • Experience supporting executives or business owners in fast-paced environments.
  • Background in healthcare or executive recruiting is preferred but not required.


Compensation and Logistics

  • Competitive monthly salary paid in USD and based on experience.
  • Full-time remote position.
  • Central Time Schedule.
  • Performance-based growth opportunities available.

title: Senior UX/UI Engineer
description:
We're seeking for a Senior UX/UI Engineer in Brazil - 100% remote


Type: 6-Month Contract (with strong potential for extension)

Location: Remote


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior UX/UI Engineer to help build and improve internal web-based user interfaces for our Site Reliability Engineering teams. This role is ideal for a front-end engineer who loves to get hands-on with React and enjoys improving user workflows, not just coding layouts.

You’ll be working on existing internal React applications (built by engineers, for engineers) — streamlining them, improving usability, and helping implement new functionality.


What You’ll Do

  • Enhance and reorganize an existing internal React app to improve usability and maintainability.
  • Build and implement intuitive web-based interfaces used daily by internal engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to identify UX pain points and deliver better workflows.
  • Bring a strong design sensibility to UI decisions, even if design is not your primary focus.


Must-Have Skills

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Atuamos em parceria com uma empresa multinacional de grande porte do setor industrial , referência em inovação, sustentabilidade e gestão responsável. Buscamos um Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori para atuação temporária até dezembro , com possibilidade de prorrogação .

O profissional participará de projetos e melhorias no módulo SAP SRH (HCM) , com foco em Benefícios (Benefits) , sendo responsável por desenvolver, customizar e manter aplicações Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP , garantindo performance, segurança e excelente experiência do usuário .


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar, adaptar ou estender aplicações SAP Fiori;
  • Atuar com codificação e arquitetura de soluções;
  • Desenvolver e customizar aplicativos SAP Fiori/UI5 voltados a processos de benefícios (adesão, consulta, alteração e cancelamento);
  • Criar e consumir serviços OData via SAP Gateway , integrando as aplicações Fiori aos dados do SRH;
  • Colaborar com consultores funcionais de RH para entendimento das regras de negócio (ex.: infotypes 0167, 0168, 0171);
  • Implementar extensões em aplicativos padrão SAP Fiori (“Meus Benefícios”, “Gerenciar Benefícios”);
  • Garantir conformidade com as diretrizes de UX/UI do SAP Fiori Design Guidelines ;
  • Realizar testes técnicos e funcionais , assegurando performance e segurança dos dados;
  • Publicar e gerenciar aplicativos no Fiori Launchpad (catálogos, grupos e roles);
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planning, review, retrospectiva) em conjunto com times funcionais, ABAP e de infraestrutura.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP Fiori e SAPUI5 (HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, XML, controllers, models);
  • Domínio em OData Services (criação, consumo e troubleshooting);
  • Conhecimento em ABAP OO para suporte às integrações com SRH;
  • Vivência com SAP Gateway (SEGW) e configuração de serviços;
  • Experiência com Fiori Launchpad , perfis de acesso (PFCG) e transportes SAP;
  • Domínio das ferramentas SAP Web IDE ou Business Application Studio (BAS) ;
  • Entendimento básico de Fiori Elements, Smart Controls e Theme Designer ;
  • Capacidade de análise de logs e resolução de incidentes em ambiente produtivo.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento dos processos funcionais de Benefícios (BEN) dentro do SRH (planos de saúde, previdência, dependentes, reembolsos);
  • Entendimento dos infotypes 0167, 0168, 0170, 0171 ;
  • Experiência em extensão de aplicativos padrão SAP ;
  • Familiaridade com DevOps, Git, CI/CD e metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban );
  • Conhecimento em SAP BTP , CAP ou desenvolvimento em ambientes cloud .



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.

  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.

Performance and Collaboration

Skills:

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.

  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
